description: Cisco Memory Pool Monitoring MIB for Cisco IOS devices

ciscoMemoryPoolTable.description: A table of memory pool monitoring entries.

ciscoMemoryPoolEntry.description: An entry containing information about a particular memory pool.

ciscoMemoryPoolType.description: Type of memory pool (1: Processor, 2: I/O, etc.)

ciscoMemoryPoolName.description: A textual description of the memory pool.

ciscoMemoryPoolValid.description: Indicates whether the memory pool entry is valid.

ciscoMemoryPoolUsed.description: Indicates the number of bytes from the pool that are currently in use by the OS.

ciscoMemoryPoolFree.description: Indicates the number of bytes from the pool that are currently free on the OS.

ciscoMemoryPoolLargestFree.description: Indicates the largest contiguous block of free memory in bytes.

ciscoMemoryPoolAlternative.description: Identifies an alternate memory pool if this one runs out.
